title: Blind Video Evaluation — Block 1 (3-Clip BWS · 43 Items) + Optional Block 2 (2AFC · 42 Items)

question2_spec.prompt: How far does the robot get with the action within the 2.5 s clip?

blocks.title: Main Block 1 — Pick Best & Worst of 3

items.prompt: A robot gripper positioned close to a grey control panel moves in and presses a red button. Close-up, static camera, realistic.
items.rater_cue: the red button and the gripper through the clip

items.prompt: A humanoid robot walks steadily down a narrow office hallway. Tracking camera from behind, realistic.
items.rater_cue: the humanoid robot's legs and torso along the hallway through the clip

items.prompt: Wind moves tall grass across an open field under a cloudy sky. Static camera, photoreal.
items.rater_cue: the tall grass and the sky across the field through the clip

items.prompt: A two-armed robot at a kitchen counter grasps a ceramic bowl with one gripper and lifts it off the counter. Static camera, soft daylight, realistic.
items.rater_cue: the ceramic bowl and the gripper through the clip

items.prompt: Three people sit at a wooden table with teacups in a cafe, talking and laughing. Handheld camera, warm indoor light, realistic.
items.rater_cue: the three people's faces, hands, and teacups at the table through the clip

items.rater_cue: the box and the gripper through the clip
items.required_action: grasp and lift a box clear of the belt
